statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2) having exactly227 actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets counted once, let r_T count those containing actual triangle T and put d_T=6-r_T. If exactly one actual triangle has deficiency three, every deficiency is zero, one, two or three; the number b of deficiency-two triangles is zero, one or two; and the number a of deficiency-one triangles is21-2b. This does not exclude count227 or assert realizability of a listed population.
assumptions: R=227 counts actual induced9-vertex rook subsets once by their vertex sets
exactly one actual triangle has d_T=6-r_T equal to three

scope.description: Universal conditional population restriction at R227 with exactly one deficiency-three triangle. Odd deficiency-one plus deficiency-three parity and actual point labels are retained; the contradiction boundary support is proved induced by target PSD, not assumed induced.

dependency_reason: Only the strict deficiency bound is inherited to force maxd3. The weaker sixteen-row R227 candidate is preserved comparison evidence, not a required verified premise. All parity, fan, weighted support and outside-point contradiction steps are reconstructed.

b3_equality.outside_degree_requirement: All three D2 triangles must meet every outside point used by one of them.
b3_equality.contradiction: At least two common points of distinct actual triangles violate linearity.

proof_route: D24 plus strict bound gives maxd3 and a+2b=21.
For b>=3 fan P<=19 forces three degree-one partners and no D2 at every D3 point.
Eighteen distinct outer C points each require an external odd D1 by local handshake.
Their total incidence capacity forces b<=3.
At b3 six external D1 triangles exactly occupy all eighteen outer points.
Known T/C/V edge weights give target Qenergy0, proving the whole21-point support induced.
Every remaining D2 has at most one support point because internal edges have fixed odd-triangle partners.
At each of its at least two outside points only three D2 nodes can be positive; degree2 forces all three there and violates linearity.

At b2 the valid3,2,2,1 local graph reaches fan weight20; no star conclusion is transferred there.
Parity capacity reaches equality at b3 and alone does not reject it.

No actual square is inferred from a collapsed defect cycle.

limitations: R227 remains unexcluded and no listed population is asserted realizable.
